description.zh: 344 行、8 列，适合缺失值、分组比较和相关性分析。
description.en: 344 rows and 8 columns for missing-value checks, group comparisons, and correlation analysis.

prompt.zh: 请先删除含 NA 的行，再按物种计算体重、鳍长、喙长和喙深的平均值。用一张汇总表比较三种企鹅，并指出每项指标的最高和最低物种。
prompt.en: After removing rows with NA, calculate the mean body mass, flipper length, bill length, and bill depth for each species. Compare the three species in one summary table and identify the highest and lowest species for each measure.

prompt.zh: 不同物种的雌雄企鹅体重差异有多大？哪些物种的差异最明显？
prompt.en: How much does body mass differ between female and male penguins within each species, and which species shows the largest difference?

prompt.zh: 企鹅的鳍越长通常会越重吗？分别看三种企鹅时，这种关系是否仍然存在？
prompt.en: Do penguins with longer flippers tend to weigh more, and does the pattern still hold when each species is considered separately?

description.zh: 21,565 行长期国家数据，适合趋势、国家比较和异常年份分析。
description.en: 21,565 country-year records for trends, cross-country comparisons, and unusual-year analysis.

prompt.zh: 只使用这六国在 year=1950 和 year=2023 的记录，计算 2023 减 1950 的预期寿命差值并排序；哪个国家提升最多？
prompt.en: Use only the records with year=1950 and year=2023 for these six countries. Calculate 2023 minus 1950, rank the gains, and identify the country with the largest increase.

prompt.zh: 在每个国家的完整时间范围内，计算相邻年份的预期寿命差值（当年减前一年），分别列出每国降幅最大的一年，并指出六国中最大的一次下降。
prompt.en: Across the complete time range available for each country, calculate year-over-year differences (current year minus previous year). Report the year with the largest drop for each country and identify the largest drop among all six.

prompt.zh: 从 2019 年到 2023 年，中国、美国、印度、日本、巴西和南非的预期寿命如何变化？到 2023 年，哪些国家已经回到或超过 2019 年水平？
prompt.en: How did life expectancy change from 2019 to 2023 in China, the United States, India, Japan, Brazil, and South Africa, and which countries had returned to or exceeded their 2019 level by 2023?

description.zh: 日表与小时表，可演示跨文件一致性、时序和高峰模式。
description.en: Daily and hourly tables for cross-file consistency, time-series, and peak-pattern analysis.

prompt.zh: 这两份数据记录的每日骑行量一致吗？如果有差异，主要出现在哪些日期和用户类型？
prompt.en: Do the two files report the same daily ride totals? If not, on which dates and for which user types do the main differences appear?

prompt.zh: 2012 年的共享单车使用量比 2011 年增长了多少？注册用户和临时用户的增长情况有什么不同？
prompt.en: How much did bike-sharing usage grow in 2012 compared with 2011, and how did the growth differ between registered and casual users?

title.zh: 工作日与非工作日高峰

prompt.zh: 工作日和非工作日的骑行高峰分别在几点？一天中的使用模式有什么不同？
prompt.en: At what times does bike-sharing usage peak on working and non-working days, and how do their daily usage patterns differ?

prompt.zh: 不同天气状况下的共享单车使用量有什么差别？哪些天气下骑行量最高或最低，这些结果的数据量是否充足？
prompt.en: How does bike-sharing usage vary with the weather? Which conditions have the highest and lowest ride volumes, and is there enough data for each comparison?

description.zh: 四张相关表，适合字段关联、收入、失业率与人群口径比较。
description.en: Four related tables for joins, earnings, unemployment, and population-definition comparisons.

prompt.zh: 用 Major_code 作为键检查 recent-grads、all-ages、grad-students 和 majors-list 的关联：共同专业有多少个？每张表各有多少个无法匹配的代码？
prompt.en: Use Major_code as the join key across recent-grads, all-ages, grad-students, and majors-list. How many majors are common to all four files, and how many codes in each file fail to match?

prompt.zh: 在 recent-grads 中按 Major_category 分组，计算每类 Median 的中位数和 Unemployment_rate 的平均值；列出收入最高、失业率最低的类别及其数值。
prompt.en: In recent-grads, group by Major_category and calculate the median of Median and the mean of Unemployment_rate for each category. Report the category with the highest income and the category with the lowest unemployment, with their values.

title.zh: 不同年龄口径收入差异

prompt.zh: 按 Major_code 对齐 recent-grads 和 all-ages，计算每个专业的 Median(all-ages) - Median(recent-grads)，列出差值最大的五个专业。
prompt.en: Join recent-grads and all-ages by Major_code. For each major, calculate Median(all-ages) minus Median(recent-grads), and list the five largest gaps.

prompt.zh: 在 recent-grads 中筛选 Median 不低于 50000 且 Unemployment_rate 低于 0.05 的专业，并按 Median 从高到低列出。
prompt.en: In recent-grads, filter for majors with Median at least 50000 and Unemployment_rate below 0.05, then list them in descending order of Median.
